terms.definition: Two bean-shaped organs that filter waste from the blood.
terms.function: Make urine and keep water and salts balanced.
terms.whereItIs: Back of the abdomen, one on each side of the spine.
terms.whyItMatters: They keep the blood clean and the body balanced.

terms.definition: The tiny filtering unit inside the kidney.
terms.function: Filters the blood and produces the fluid that becomes urine.
terms.whyItMatters: Nephrons are where the actual filtering happens.

terms.definition: The liquid waste the kidneys produce.
terms.function: Carries waste and extra water out of the body.
terms.whereItIs: Made in the kidneys, stored in the bladder.
terms.whyItMatters: It is how the body safely removes waste.

terms.definition: The muscular sac that stores urine.
terms.function: Holds urine until it is released.
terms.whyItMatters: It lets the body store waste until it can be released.

terms.definition: The tube carrying urine from kidney to bladder.
terms.whereItIs: Connecting each kidney to the bladder.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the delivery pipe for urine.
